name: Peter
bio: Simon, called Peter, was a fisherman on the Sea of Galilee when Jesus called him and his brother Andrew to follow him and become "fishers of men"; they immediately left their nets to do so (Matthew 4:18-20). His prominent, often impulsive role among the disciples is told in detail in the chapters ahead. When Jesus entered Peter's house, he healed Peter's mother-in-law of a fever with a touch (Matthew 8:14-15). When Jesus walked on the water during a storm, Peter asked to join him and briefly walked on the water himself, but began to sink when fear overtook his faith; Jesus caught him and gently rebuked his doubt (Matthew 14:28-31). When the disciples asked for clarification on Jesus's teaching that defilement comes from the heart rather than food, Peter was the one who asked him to explain the saying (Matthew 15:15-20).
